answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: The activation profile matches fine-tune backdoor almost exactly. Onset is at layer 3 (the early bump). Relative L2 is 0.086/0.164/0.162/0.191/0.297, against the document's 0.091/0.174/0.169/0.193/0.295. Size ratio is 1.018, effective rank 3.62, direction consistency 0.625, final cosine 0.952, final jump +0.038 and layer-2 spike 1.2. On the logit side, KL is 0.124, raw-score shift ÷ TV is 3.9 and the activation-to-logit ratio is 2.4, all close to that class. The text agrees: refusals fall (1 added, 3 dropped) and disclaimers fall (3.1% vs 7.8%). Fine-tune bias is ruled out by consistency 0.625 rather than 0.70, the raw-score shift of 3.9 rather than ~10, the small final jump and the drop in refusals. Quantization is ruled out by the size ratio being above 1 and the rank being below 4. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the small layer-2 spike, the low mid-depth difference (0.16 at layer 16) and the absence of preference, stage-direction or marker text. The median first divergence of 3.5 is somewhat early but within plausible variation.
